newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuadorean banana producers strike over prices.
newsitem.headline: Ecuadorean banana producers strike over prices.

text.p: Ecuadorean banana producers began an indefinite strike Monday in protest against the official prices for the fruit, blocking major highways with burning tires and dumping loads of bananas on roads.
"We successfully blocked the main coast roads," National Banana Producers Association marketing director Simon Canarte told Reuters.
Association representatives were due to meet President Fabian Alarcon later Monday to seek an end to the protest, which began after the government lowered official banana prices, Canarte said.

The Association groups two-thirds of the country's 5,600 banana producers, but the head of another body, the National Banana Producers' Corporation, Enrique Gomez, said that his members too will go on strike from Tuesday.
Ecuador is the world's largest banana producer.
